scope.purpose: Combined completeness/current-norm audit of adjacent Grade-9 syntax/function chunks; no physical bank mutation.

current_academic_crosscheck.source: Gramota.ru — junction of conjunctions / academic rule explanations
Gramota.ru — complex sentence: conjunction vs relative word
Gramota.ru — answer 322445: LI as conjunction-particle in an explanatory subordinate clause

current_model: comma normally separates clauses of a compound sentence
with single И / ДА(=И) / ИЛИ / ЛИБО it may be absent when clauses have a genuine common secondary member
same no-comma model applies with a common subordinate clause and other academically specified strong common structural/intonational conditions
decisions.learner_policy: Existence of И is never enough; first prove separate predicative bases and the genuinely common component.

decisions.current_norm_note: Treat these as concrete paired/gradation constructions. Do not infer that every first component has one immutable second partner in all current Russian usage.
decisions.patch_policy: Keep one cross-grade decision identity with member-level diagnostics, not one identity per memorized pair.

current_model: at a junction of conjunctions a comma is used when the second subordinate conjunction is single and the inserted subordinate can be structurally removed/rearranged
when the subordinate conjunction is part of a double construction with correlating ТО in the main continuation, the comma at the junction is normally absent
sentence-initial and other structures require full syntactic analysis
decisions.learner_policy: The mnemonic 'есть ТО — нет запятой' is a result of structural analysis, not a replacement for it.

decisions.current_model: A subordinating conjunction only links clauses and is not a member of the subordinate clause; a relative word is a pronoun/pronominal adverb and has its own syntactic role inside the subordinate clause.
diagnostics: possible replacement by a content word where appropriate
phrasal stress can support the distinction
decisions.learner_policy: Never classify ЧТО / КОГДА / КАК outside the sentence.

current_bsp_model: second clause supplies explanatory/indirect-question content after perception/thought predicates
decisions.simple_sentence_model: colon after a generalizing word before an enumeration is a different syntactic mechanism
decisions.current_variation: In an asyndetic complex sentence expressing explanation, cause, justification or explanatory content, current academic rules allow dash instead of colon in a range of contexts, especially expressive/publicistic ones.
decisions.patch_policy: Keep the diagnostic contrast; never teach 'BSP of this semantic type = only colon'.

current_model: LI in a direct/general question functions as a question particle
in an explanatory subordinate clause introducing an indirect yes/no question, current reference practice describes LI as союз-частица / conjunctional element
repeated LI may participate in disjunctive constructions, requiring whole-construction analysis
decisions.patch_policy: Use function and clause structure; preserve the practical boundary while allowing modern reference terminology союз-частица rather than forcing a single school label in every use.
